# Averitt expands logistics network with Jackson, Mississippi, facility

 August 27, 2026 

Less-than-truckload carrier Averitt said Thursday it has opened a 100,000-square-foot distribution and fulfillment facility in Jackson, Mississippi. The announcement follows other recent investments the carrier has made to its network.

The new warehouse is near central Mississippi’s major freight lanes of I-20 and I-55. The Mississippi Department of Transportation announced Tuesday a $400 million project to improve the roadways and bridges along these corridors. The plan also calls for rail upgrades.

Most national LTL carriers have nearby service centers and Averitt operates a 57-door LTL terminal next to the new facility. 

Cookeville, Tennessee-based Averitt’s latest addition will serve rail connections and provide service to ports in New Orleans and Mobile, Alabama. Customers will be able to flex the amount of space needed for seasonal and overflow inventory projects without committing to long-term contracts.

 August 11, 2026 By Canadian Plastics 

The new facility in Laval positions inventory closer to businesses throughout Quebec.

TricorBraun has opened a new warehouse facility in Laval, Quebec, enhancing its distribution network in Canada. The facility aims to improve delivery times and product availability for businesses across Quebec, according to an Aug. 10 press release.

- The warehouse is strategically located near Highways 15 and 440, facilitating access to major transportation routes.
- Yvan Lapointe, regional vice president, stated the investment underscores TricorBraun's commitment to supporting Canadian operations.
- The new centre will enable faster deliveries and reduced supply chain complexity by stocking inventory locally.

This expansion is significant for businesses in Quebec, as it allows for quicker response times to market demands and enhances overall supply chain efficiency.

## Savers to open new Northampton distribution centre

27th August 2026

Yasmeen Louis

Savers is to open a new distribution centre in Northampton in late 2026, as it invests in additional capacity to support the retailer’s growth.

The site will be managed by GXO, which has worked with Savers for more than 25 years, and is expected to create up to 275 local jobs.

The new facility will provide additional capacity and flexibility across the retailer’s distribution network as the retailer progresses with an ambitious store-opening programme over the next three years.

Savers’ existing distribution centre will remain operational and continue to support stores and customers.

Savers supply chain director Mark Peaker said: “This new distribution centre is an important step in supporting our continued growth.

“With an ambitious store opening programme over the next three years, it strengthens our network and gives us the additional capacity and flexibility we need for the future, helping us serve our stores and customers even more effectively.
